turns.sql:
WITH district_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.District_ID,
        AVG(s.Number_of_product_category) AS avg_product_category
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID
),
filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Store_ID,
        s.Store_Name,
        s.Ranking,
        s.Number_of_product_category,
        d.City_Population / d.City_Area AS population_density,
        da.avg_product_category
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
    JOIN district_avg da ON sd.District_ID = da.District_ID
    WHERE (d.City_Population / d.City_Area) >= 5000  -- ASSUMPTION: Federal threshold for 'High-Growth Zone'
      AND s.Number_of_product_category > da.avg_product_category
)
SELECT 
    fs.*,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fs.Ranking ASC) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS percentile_rank
FROM filtered_stores fs
WHERE (CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fs.Ranking ASC) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()) <= 10
